import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

	public static int Num;
	public static String Line;
	public static int maxVal = 0;
	public static int wordCount = 0;
	public static int wordLen = 0;
	public static int i;

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner buff = new Scanner(System.in);

		while (buff.hasNextLine()) {
			String num = buff.nextLine();
			Num = Integer.parseInt(num);
			Line = buff.nextLine();
			char[] Text = Line.toCharArray();

			for (i = 0; i < Num; i++) {
				if (Text[i] != '_' && Text[i] != '(' && Text[i] != ')') {
					wordLen++;
				} else if (Text[i] == '_') {
					if (wordLen > maxVal) {
						maxVal = wordLen;
					}
					wordLen = 0;
				} else if (Text[i] == '(') {
					if (wordLen > maxVal) {
						maxVal = wordLen;
					}
					wordLen = 0;
					i++;
					while (Text[i] != '\0') {
						if (Text[i] != '_' && Text[i] != '(' && Text[i] != ')') {
							wordLen++;
							i++;
						} else if (Text[i] == '_') {
							if (wordLen != 0) {
								wordCount++;
								wordLen = 0;
							}
							i++;
							if (Text[i] == ')') {
								break;
							}
						} else if (Text[i] == ')') {
							if (wordLen != 0) {
								wordCount++;
								wordLen = 0;
							}
							// i++;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (wordLen > maxVal) {
				maxVal = wordLen;
			}
			wordLen = 0;

			System.out.println(maxVal + " " + wordCount);
		}
	}

}
